description_en: Model prediction supports information extraction from long documents, single receipts, and tables
description_zh: 模型预测分为三种类型：长文档信息抽取、单票据信息抽取、表格信息抽取
name: PredictModel

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image or PDF file
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The version of the model. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the latest active version of the model by default
parameters.help_zh: 模型对应的版本号，如果不传入版本号表示默认用模型最新生效的版本
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: The model ID. You can find the model ID on the Model List page
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.example:
false：表示content传入的是url
true：表示body是直接传入图片进行base64的内容
parameters.help_en: Specifies how the input document is provided. Set this to `true` if you provide the document content as a base64-encoded string in the `Body` parameter. Set this to `false` if you provide the document's URL in the `Content` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
content字段是图片URL时：false
body为base64的内容时：true
parameters.name: binary_to_text

parameters.help_en: The base64-encoded content of the image file. Use this parameter when `BinaryToText` is set to `true`
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: The status code of the request. A value of `200` indicates success
